title: A claude-settings check proves every module a raw-fetched shared script imports is in the child repos' documented fetch list
why: Sighting (coordinator 08:01 CST Nov 14, from runner 11; cause read from runner 11's message and log line, not read by the coordinator in the run; triage read nothing): child repos fetch check_shared_resources.py, layout.py and layout.json as raw URLs at a pin. layout.py at stable (fccff95) imports git_reads, which that fetch list lacks, so degen #704 went red on its first ready run (run 43602367466, step "shared resources": ModuleNotFoundError git_reads). Mistake: a change to a fetched script's imports shipped with no check that the child fetch lists cover them. Guard that would have stopped it: a claude-settings check that every module a raw-fetched script imports is in the documented fetch list. Red first: add an import of a module outside the list to one fetched script and the check fails; remove it and it passes. Scan the imports with Python's own parser (ast), not by matching strings. A check change in claude-settings, so round 3 applies. The coordinator's pick on #704: option A, revert the three pins to 635b37b (labelled the coordinator's own). CAUSE 08:24 CST Nov 14 (runner 11 via the coordinator 08:22): runner 11's own check of the fetched scripts ran from a FULL clone of claude-settings, so the missing git_reads file did not show. So the check this step builds must run against only the files the fetch list names (a clean directory holding just those), not a clone, or it passes when the list is short. Degen #704 merged after a one-line revert of the three raw URLs to 635b37b (equal to main).
note: Filed 08:03 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. No lane yet. The guard the coordinator named: slug child-fetch-list-covers-imports.
